Item 2. Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations

Overview

Astra Semiconductor Inc. (the "Company") designs and sells analog semiconductor components for industrial and automotive customers. During the quarter ended June 30, 2024, the Company continued to see strong demand from automotive customers, partially offset by softness in industrial end markets.

Results of Operations

The following table presents selected results for the three months ended June 30, 2024 and 2023 (in thousands, except per share data):

(in thousands)Three Months Ended June 30, 2024Three Months Ended June 30, 2023
Total revenue$1,250,000$1,100,000
Gross profit$524,000$462,000
Net income$150,000$120,000
Interest expense($18,500)($15,200)
Long-term debt$2,100,000$1,500,000

Revenue increased 13.6% year-over-year, driven primarily by increased unit volumes in our automotive analog product line.

Item 1A. Risk Factors

There have been no material changes to the risk factors previously disclosed in our Annual Report on Form 10-K, except as set forth below.

On May 14, 2024, a former supplier filed a complaint against the Company in the Superior Court of California alleging breach of contract related to a terminated supply agreement. The Company believes the claims are without merit and intends to defend the litigation vigorously. Given the early stage of this matter, the Company cannot reasonably estimate the range of possible loss, if any.
